title: Flatness at a specified closed boundary point of the closed fibre
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian local ring of depth at least two with closed point $a$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-depth]. Let $q:L\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $U\subset L$ be open, contain every point not lying over $a$, and have dense inverse image in the scheme-theoretic closed fibre $L_a$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $p:E\to L$ be finite and etale over $U$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Suppose $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{E,z}\ge2$ for every $z$ with $p(z)\notin U$. For a closed point $x\in L_a$ whose image $y\in L$ does not belong to $U$, and any $z\in E$ with $p(z)=y$, the local ring map $\mathcal O_{L,y}\to\mathcal O_{E,z}$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism]. No flatness away from this specified target point is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0EYB (pione-lemma-purity-smooth-over-depth2), proof from the choice of a closed point through formal completion and descent; Tags 0EY6(2),(a),(b), 07NE, 057G, 05D5, 00MB, 0EYA and 0337

proof.text: Construct a flat power-series test t:T to L through the given closed boundary point, with positive number of variables, base depth at least two, and the two required conditions on the inverse image of U. This construction uses no finite cover.
Restrict the pullback square over U. Mathlib Hom.isPullback_resLE and stability of Etale under base change show that the finite pullback r:E times_L T to T is etale over t inverse image U.

The first projection E times_L T to E is flat. Its stalk maps are flat and local. Both source and target stalk rings are Noetherian. Apply the flat local depth formula to show that the depth of each boundary stalk of the pullback is at least the depth of its image stalk on E, hence at least two.
Apply the power-series finite-extension flatness theorem to r, using the open conditions supplied by the test construction and the boundary depth just proved.

Pick b in T mapping to the closed fibre point. Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback lifts z and b to a point w of E times_L T. The first-projection stalk map at w is flat and local, hence faithfully flat. The stalk map of the composite to L is flat since it also factors through the flat map r and the flat test t. Faithfully flat descent proves flatness of p.stalkMap z: tensor an injective linear map with the target stalk, then with the faithfully flat pullback stalk, use flatness of the composite and tensor associativity, and reflect injectivity. This descent is fully written in Lean using Mathlib tensor-injectivity criteria.

theorem flat_stalk_of_smooth_local_depth_two_closed_fiber
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {L : Scheme.{u}} (q : L ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [Smooth q]
    (U : L.Opens)
    (haway : ∀ y : L, q y ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A → y ∈ U)
    (hclosed : Dense (↑((q.fiberι (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)) ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
      Set (q.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A))))
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    {E : Scheme.{u}} (p : E ⟶ L) [IsFinite p] [Etale (p ∣_ U)]
    (hboundary : ∀ z : E, p z ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk z) (E.presheaf.stalk z))
    (x : q.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set _))
    (hout : q.fiberι (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) x ∉ U)
    (z : E) (hz : p z = q.fiberι (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) x) :
    (p.stalkMap z).hom.Flat
